how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-07-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:92109:title: My First ⟦E27⟧ Set
rows.quest:92109:obj:0: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 ⟦E29⟧, and 5 ⟦E30⟧ to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:92109:details:0: Erm... 'Ello, . I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!
rows.quest:92109:details:1: When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.
rows.quest:92109:details:2: Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
rows.quest:92109:progress:0: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
rows.quest:92110:title: My First Real Potion
rows.quest:92110:obj:0: Gather 3 ⟦E33⟧ Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:92110:details:0: Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?
rows.quest:92110:details:1: That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.
rows.quest:92110:details:2: I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
rows.quest:92110:progress:0: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
